question: Should this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91277 be retargeted from a no-public-listing clarification to publishing the current official iOS App Store link on the iOS platform page?
rationale: The repository and Apple lookup now show an official public App Store app, while the open closing PR says the opposite, so a release-owner/product wording decision is needed before landing public docs.

options.title: Retarget To Official App Store Link
options.body: Confirm the official URL, update the iOS platform page with that link and a warning about similarly named apps, and have the linked PR revised or replaced.

options.title: Pause Until Release Owner Confirms
options.body: Keep this issue open and block docs changes until an iOS release owner confirms whether the current App Store listing is ready for broad public docs.

options.title: Keep Current PR Direction
options.body: Land the no-public-listing wording only if maintainers determine the live Apple lookup should not be treated as the public install path yet.

recommendation.title: Retarget To Official App Store Link
recommendation.body: Confirm the official URL, update the iOS platform page with that link and a warning about similarly named apps, and have the linked PR revised or replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the relevant iOS App Store/App Review release work and earlier App Store metadata updates.
